scope: Native keyboard/mouse input, frozen profiles/controllers, retryable event batches, fixed-tick consumption and optional Windows Game-view controls.

checks: Frozen controller discovery and strict playing/Game-camera focus gates work without requiring graphics.
Real controller movement/jump/yaw matches evaluated controls; held movement persists, while look/jump/use consume once and repeat events/receipts cannot retrigger them.
Invalid batches validate atomically; reserved/gamepad/type/shape/count errors preserve pending input and failed receipts are reusable.
Focus loss, Pause and Scene switch clear held controls and pending edges; explicit reacquisition does not restore stale movement.
Persisted rebound profile changes actual movement and yaw/pitch; stale profile revisions reject without disturbing the old evaluator.
Stop/new session drops configuration and rejects stale events; independent semantic replay exactly matches final controller/camera state with unchanged authored bytes/history.
After actual recursive authored deletion, frozen runtime controller/camera discovery, configuration and movement remain valid; Stop restores the now-empty authored controller list.
limitations: Native ABI/HWND automation, not physical Avalonia widget qualification.
No GPU supplied: capture hold and native viewport detach checks were not run.

checks: No graphics at create; unchanged polling and unattached draw; duplicate/invalid handle rejection.
Discoverable JSON-RPC methods, malformed request/notification behavior, shared-owner/graphics restrictions.
Off-thread calls reject without transferring WorldSession ownership or mutating state.
Independent CLI process shares authoritative revision/entities and stale edits remain atomic.
Camera patches validate before mutation; unavailable captures/invalid HWND preserve authoring.
GPU-independent picking: nearest visible geometry, no-hit, top-left coordinates, true triangle/rotated-box intersections, clipping and strict atomic guards.
Framing combines visible descendants, respects aspect/clipping, preserves orientation, supports non-rendered entities and never edits world bytes.
Runtime picking/framing uses frozen geometry and hierarchy after authored deletion/reparenting without advancing ticks.
GPU-independent skin picking follows edited joint poses and excludes obsolete rest geometry.
Host destruction releases writer ownership and endpoint; frontend HWND survives; committed edits survive reopen.
Playback/view schemas are discoverable; invalid camera selection is atomic and Game excludes Scene interaction tools.
Paused clock and detached draw remain inert; Step advances exactly once with core receipt retry and strict session guards.
Only owner poll advances real time; long stalls cap at eight ticks, competing runtime mutations reject, and paused wall time never catches up.
Existing runtime.start/stop synchronize with the desktop driver, defaulting external starts to paused.
Game uses the same runtime with its frozen camera lens and hierarchy despite authored camera edits and deletion.
A genuine animation sampling failure rolls back the entire batch, pauses playback, exposes the error, and preserves authored bytes/history.
Strict schemas, stale begin and handle misses preserve authored state without graphics initialization.
No-movement commit creates no revision, history entry or storage write.
Preview/cancel leaves storage/history untouched; snapped commit produces one undo entry with idempotent retry, undo and redo.
A valid unparented world rotation produces a normalized preview without changing position/scale or authored storage.
Camera, selection, tool configuration, authored revision and runtime transitions invalidate pending gestures without committing previews.
Parent-affine world movement converts to local TRS; sheared world rotation rejects atomically; local axis scale preserves positive other axes.

limitations: GUI input tests use targeted owned-HWND messages and synthetic relative motion. They do not qualify physical raw mouse hardware, clipping restoration, international keyboards, accessibility or input feel.
Script mode intentionally does not register raw devices, confine or hide the OS cursor. Production capture has separate foreground/ownership checks.
Editor gamepad input and audio output remain unfinished; standalone player support is unchanged.
Tablet/remote-desktop absolute raw mouse packets remain unsupported for Game-view look.
GPU coverage is one Windows laptop with NVIDIA and AMD devices; no broad hardware or shipping-performance qualification.
Only public test summaries and source/binary digests are included. Detailed local artifacts remain under the ignored build directory.
